title: Mechanism of ribonucleoprotein low complexity domain molecule oligomerization: Experimental investigations and theoretical modeling.
authors: Zeliszewska, Paulina; Shah, Pooja; Rakowski, Kamil; Wojciechowski, Jakub W; Wosztyl, Aleksandra; Kluza, Anna; Michna, Aneta; Adamczyk, Zbigniew; Bratek-Skicki, Anna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究hnRNPA2低复杂度结构域蛋白的寡聚化机制，结合实验与分子动力学模拟，虽涉及RNA结合蛋白但非TF-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-核酸互作建模。
abstract: Nucleation of RNA-binding proteins is the first step in forming functional RNA-protein complexes (RNPs), which control various aspects of RNA metabolism. Nucleation of proteins involved in neurodegeneration can occur through an oligomerization process; however, the mechanism which causes this process remains unknown. Therefore, in this work, we focused on the study of the oligomeric structure of the heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein A2 low complexity domain (hnRNPA2 LCD) molecule, one of the important proteins involved in RNA metabolism. Various experimental and theoretical techniques were applied to determine essential physicochemical parameters of the protein in solutions of various ionic strengths and pHs. The protein monomer size, its cross-sectional area, and the dependence of nominal charge on pH, comprising the isoelectric point, were theoretically evaluated. This data allowed the determination of the adsorption kinetics of hnRNPA2 LCD molecules on mica and polymer microparticles using the streaming potential measurements and laser Doppler velocimetry, respectively. It was shown that the protein was adsorbed in the form of oligomers, the size distribution of which was determined by atomic force microscopy. Additionally, molecular dynamics modeling was applied to gain insight into the mechanism of pH-driven changes in protein molecule conformations and their influence on the oligomerization process. Besides its significance to basic science, the acquired results enabled the development of an effective method for quantifying the oligomerization kinetics of unstable protein solutions.
abstract_zh: RNA结合蛋白的成核是形成功能性RNA-蛋白质复合物（RNPs）的第一步，这些复合物调控RNA代谢的多个方面。参与神经退行性疾病的蛋白质成核可通过寡聚化过程发生；然而，引发该过程的机制仍属未知。因此，在本工作中，我们聚焦于异质核核糖核蛋白A2低复杂度结构域（hnRNPA2 LCD）分子寡聚结构的研究，该蛋白是参与RNA代谢的重要蛋白质之一。我们应用多种实验和理论技术，以确定该蛋白在不同离子强度和pH值溶液中的关键物理化学参数。理论上评估了蛋白质单体的尺寸、其横截面积以及标称电荷对pH的依赖性（包括等电点）。这些数据使得利用流式电位测量和激光多普勒测速法分别测定hnRNPA2 LCD分子在云母和聚合物微粒上的吸附动力学成为可能。结果表明，该蛋白以寡聚体形式吸附，其尺寸分布通过原子力显微镜确定。此外，应用分子动力学模拟以深入了解pH驱动的蛋白质分子构象变化机制及其对寡聚化过程的影响。除对基础科学的意义外，所获结果还促成了量化不稳定蛋白质溶液寡聚化动力学的有效方法的开发。
